newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako down 13.8 pct after flood damage.
newsitem.headline: Rafako down 13.8 pct after flood damage.

text.p: Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA fell 13.8 percent in light trade to 11.2 zlotys on Wednesday, resuming trade after a suspension since July 11 due to flooding.
On Wednesday Rafako, based in flood-hit Raciborz, traded without the daily 10-percent price-fluctuation limit.
On Monday the firm gave an 18.9-million-zloty preliminary flood damage estimate but said this year's sales forecast of 370 million zlotys had not been changed.
Traders said the stock should begin to move along with the overall market. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
